description: This file is a FastAPI application implementing a WebSocket chat interface. It serves an HTML page with JavaScript for WebSocket communication and defines WebSocket endpoint handlers that process incoming messages, handle cookies and query parameters, and send responses back to clients.

methods.name: get()
methods.description: Handles the root GET request, returning an HTML page with WebSocket client code.

methods.name: get_cookie_or_token( websocket: WebSocket, session: str | None = Cookie(default=None), token: str | None = Query(default=None), )
methods.description: Dependency that retrieves session cookie or token query parameter for WebSocket connections; raises exception if neither is provided.

methods.name: websocket_endpoint( websocket: WebSocket, item_id: str, q: int | None = None, cookie_or_token: str = Depends(get_cookie_or_token), )
methods.description: WebSocket endpoint that accepts a connection, then echoes received messages along with session/token info and query parameter 'q'.
